title: Diagnostic Report: PlazaVea (InRetail / Intercorp)
summary: PlazaVea's site has strong SERP positioning (#1 for brand and category keywords) and approximately 7.6M monthly visits, but severe performance issues (Lighthouse 29-39, LCP up to 15.8s on PDPs) and structural SEO gaps (no JSON-LD, no reviews, template meta descriptions, no editorial content) limit conversion and organic growth potential across a catalog of 400+ product sitemaps.
